d: An Infrastructure Engineer / Cloud Engineer designs, deploys, automates, and maintains the core cloud and on-premise IT systems that keep applications reliable, secure, and scalable
Cloud & Virtualization Management: Deploy, configure, and manage cloud environments (such as AWS, Azure, GCP, or OpenStack), virtual machines, storage, and compute resources.
Infrastructure as Code (IaC) & Automation: Write IaC scripts using tools like Terraform or Ansible to automate provisioning and reduce manual deployment errors.
CI/CD & DevOps Support: Help build and maintain Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines alongside development and SRE teams.
System Administration & Networking: Administer Linux/Windows servers, manage packages and file systems, and configure network interfaces, VLANs, load balancers, and firewalls.
Monitoring & Incident Response: Track system health, resource utilization, and uptime dashboards, troubleshoot outages, and resolve infrastructure incidents.
Security & Compliance: Implement security best practices, manage identity and access
q: Technical Experience: 6+ years in IT infrastructure, systems administration, or cloud engineering.
Cloud Platforms: Hands-on experience with AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud (GCP) , or private cloud stacks like OpenStack .
Scripting & IaC: Proficiency in scripting (Bash, Python) and configuration/automation tools (Terraform, Ansible, Kubernetes, Docker).
Operating Systems: Strong command of Linux (RHEL/Ubuntu) and/or Windows Server administration.
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

This role works closely with Legal, Licensing, Product, Operations and regional teams to support operational readiness and ongoing compliance activities.
